g.text: Detailed model - configured domain and recorded facts
Immutable historical values, not a second file.
Intended facts do not prove an action completed.
Exactly one IntendedAfter; at most one Before.
Before is absent for initial organization.
A designated place, not a deletion deadline.
The physical folder is created on demand.
Multiplicities describe one configured profile and its retained file history.
/ = derived value. [0..1] = optional. No methods or database keys are modeled.
Lifecycle and expected content are absent before tracking; see the text for value domains.
